§15.3 diagram label-overlap fix. Yaniv inspected the preview and flagged that some text sits ON the drawing in the arch-sections diagram (page 39), asking whether the SSOT forbids it and whether it happens elsewhere. It does: SSOT §15.3 requires labels/numbers/units not to overlap the lines.
